name: get_current_date
description: Returns the calendar the agent must read every date out of. Call this at the START of any booking, rescheduling, or availability check, before any date is spoken. It returns today's date, the current time, and `days`: today plus the next 13 days, each already carrying its date, its day_of_week, whether the clinic is open, and how to say it aloud. It also returns `next_by_day_of_week`, mapping each weekday name to the soonest date after today that falls on it. NEVER work a weekday or a date out yourself and NEVER count days forward: find the row and read the date and the day_of_week off it together. If a date is not in this table, say you will check and call this tool again.
execution_message_description: No spoken message needed — this is a silent background call.

name: check_availability
description: Check if a specific date and time is available for an appointment. Always call this before offering or confirming any time slot. If no time is provided, returns all available slots for that day.
execution_message_description: Silent — no spoken message during availability check.

date.description: The appointment date in YYYY-MM-DD format, copied from a row of the get_current_date table. Never calculate it from a spoken day such as 'next Tuesday' — look that day up instead.

time.description: The specific time to check in HH:MM 24-hour format (e.g. '10:00', '14:30'). Optional — if omitted, all available slots for the day are returned.

service.description: The name of the service the caller wants to book (e.g. 'Acupuncture', 'Massage'). Optional but improves accuracy.

duration_minutes.description: Appointment duration in minutes. Optional — defaults to the service's standard duration.

expected_day_of_week.description: The weekday the caller actually said, as a plain weekday name ('Wednesday'). Send it whenever the caller named a day rather than a calendar date, alongside the date you read out of get_current_date. The backend checks the two against each other and refuses the call with DAY_OF_WEEK_MISMATCH if the date you sent falls on a different weekday — which means you picked the wrong row. Never derive this from your own date; it must be the caller's word.

name: find_appointment
description: Privately locate one confirmed appointment before rescheduling or cancellation. The call handler must send the actual caller number in the configured x-caller-phone header. If more than one appointment matches, ask for the original date and exact time and call again. Pass the returned appointment_id and appointment_token unchanged to the write tool; never speak the token.
execution_message_description: Silent — appointment details are returned only after caller-number verification.

phone.description: The phone number the appointment was booked under. It must match the verified caller number supplied by the call handler.

appointment_date.description: Original appointment date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Include this to disambiguate multiple appointments.

appointment_time.description: Original appointment time in HH:MM format. Include this with the date if needed to select exactly one appointment.

appointment_token.description: On the second lookup call, pass the private selection token returned by the first call. Never speak this value.

name: create_appointment
description: Book an appointment after availability has been confirmed. Only call this after check_availability has returned available=true AND the caller has confirmed all details. Use full_name (not caller_name) for the patient name.
execution_message_description: Silent — do not speak while this runs. Confirmation is spoken AFTER the tool returns.

full_name.description: The caller's full name collected in booking Step 6.

phone.description: The caller's phone number collected in booking Step 7.

email.description: The caller's email address. Optional — only include if provided.

service.description: The exact name of the service being booked (e.g. 'Acupuncture (60 min)', 'Massage Therapy (60 min)').

date.description: The appointment date in YYYY-MM-DD format, the same date check_availability just confirmed and the caller agreed to. It must come from a row of the get_current_date table.

time.description: The appointment start time in HH:MM 24-hour format.

first_visit.description: True if first visit, false if returning patient. From booking Step 8.

referral_source.description: How the caller heard about the practice. From booking Step 10.

notes.description: Sport, injury, or accident context from Step 9. Any other relevant notes.

expected_day_of_week.description: The weekday the caller actually said, as a plain weekday name ('Wednesday'). Send it whenever the caller named a day rather than a calendar date, alongside the date you read out of get_current_date. The backend checks the two against each other and refuses the call with DAY_OF_WEEK_MISMATCH if the date you sent falls on a different weekday — which means you picked the wrong row. Never derive this from your own date; it must be the caller's word.

name: reschedule_appointment
description: Reschedule the exact appointment selected by find_appointment. Always check availability for the new slot first. Pass appointment_id and appointment_token exactly as returned; never speak the token.
execution_message_description: Say something like: 'Let me update that appointment for you...'

phone.description: The phone number the original appointment was booked under. Used to look up the appointment.

appointment_id.description: The appointment ID returned by find_appointment.

appointment_token.description: The private appointment selection token returned by find_appointment. Never speak this value.

new_date.description: The new appointment date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

new_time.description: The new appointment start time in HH:MM 24-hour format.

name: cancel_appointment
description: Cancel the exact appointment selected by find_appointment. Pass appointment_id and appointment_token exactly as returned; never speak the token.
execution_message_description: Say something like: 'Let me take care of that cancellation for you...'

phone.description: The phone number the appointment was booked under.

appointment_id.description: The appointment ID returned by find_appointment.

appointment_token.description: The private appointment selection token returned by find_appointment. Never speak this value.

name: create_callback
description: Save a callback request when a caller wants to be called back by the team. Use this when the caller can't get what they need right now, prefers to speak with a human, or explicitly asks for a callback.
execution_message_description: Say something like: 'I'll get that request in for you right now...'

name: search_services
description: Search for services by name, category, or symptom. Use this when a caller asks what services are offered, asks about a specific treatment, or describes a symptom or condition.
execution_message_description: No spoken message needed — response is fast.

query.description: The search query — can be a service name, symptom, category, or natural language phrase like 'what do you offer for skin' or 'something for stress'.
